question: Can a query-free doubling rule restore compact-field capability when the fixed D256/L128 bottleneck fails before any benchmark is opened?

trigger_authority.trigger: Both D256/L128 arms failed the preregistered source-only direction and official-capability gates.

generic_capacity_rule.local_dimension: equal to coefficient_dimension so no unregistered secondary intrinsic-dimension bottleneck remains
generic_capacity_rule.basis: trainable after the same source-only affine PCA initialization
generic_capacity_rule.selection: Choose the first dimension in ascending order that passes every unchanged source-only gate. Stop without benchmark opening if none passes.

current_candidate.reason: D256 is already rejected; 512 is the next deterministic doubling step.

orthogonal_support_fix: Capacity promotion does not waive the sparse exact-marginal support requirement. LERF benchmark opening additionally requires the shared raw/DINO/SAM support authority to pass exact parity and coverage gates.

gpu_policy.check_frequency: stage boundaries or approximately every 180 seconds
gpu_policy.thermal_stop: at least 88 Celsius in two consecutive checks
